subject: general
question: **Select the most appropriate option to fill In blank number 1.**
solution:
The correct answer is: '**a**'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The blank requires an indefinite article to introduce a singular countable noun.
 
• "**A**" is an indefinite article used before a consonant sound.
 
 
• **For example**: *I saw a cat in the garden.*
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is **option 1**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• "**That**" is a conjunction used to introduce a subordinate clause or as a demonstrative pronoun. 
 
• "**Their**" is a possessive determiner used to indicate ownership by plural nouns or third-person singular nouns. 
 
• "**Some**" is an indefinite determiner used to indicate an unspecified amount or number of something.
